reviews.title: The apps are great but there is no support team
reviews.text:
Hopefully this is a warning for other parents; I had paid for months for the school app only and then through the app upgraded to the unlimited plan.

I was then charged for both the school app AND unlimited plan for months. Once I realized I canceled the school app plan, because the school app is in the unlimited apps. Now that I’ve done that I’m no longer able to access any of the school app activities and it does not recognize my subscription. I’ve canceled and resubscribed, I’ve uninstalled and redownloaded and it makes no difference. Now I’m paying for things I AM NOT AT ALL RECEIVING and I’ve sent multiple messages to support since September of 2025 when I realized. Not one single message has been responded to, there is no way to even confirm they have received the messages and I’m so incredibly disappointed.

Fix your broken system and terrible support!!

I think if you give people more things for free then the game would be better. I downloaded it today and when I loaded it up the screen was white. If this is a bug or glitch please try and fix it. Thank you for making a good game.
